messages:
maria: opened PR to rework metering header examples and add a tiny migration guide for new quota tiers. preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4529

sam: reading it. what are the exact header changes?

maria: adding `tier` and `allocation_id` to X-Redwood-Metering. example in docs: ```
X-Redwood-Metering: {"account_id":"acct_123","tier":"enterprise","allocation_id":"alloc-42"}
```

Also clarified difference between per-route and per-account quota enforcement and removed an ambiguous paragraph that referenced legacy rate tiers.

tyler: note: observability renamed the dashboard metric from `requests_per_min` to `ingest_rps` yesterday. screenshots in the docs will be out-of-date. I left a note to keep the alias for 14 days. @kevin is billing ok with that?

kevin: billing agrees to the alias window. add a short migration footnote and an example alias mapping in the migration guide.

sam: I'll add a minimal migration snippet showing SDKs can accept either metric name. Also updating curl/python/js examples to avoid JSON-escaping pitfalls. Proposed curl: `curl -H 'X-Redwood-Metering: {"account_id":"acct_123","tier":"pro"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate`

jin: docs-bot: started preview build for PR #4529
jin: docs-bot: build succeeded: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4529

maria: can someone proof the Python snippet? I used `json.dumps` to construct the header to avoid backslash hell.

sam: LGTM. small nit: change `allocation_id` example to hyphenated format (alloc-9) to match other infra docs.

maria: done. Also fixed the broken link in the quota table (it pointed at /pricing/old-tiers). replaced with canonical /pricing/tiers and added redirects note.

tyler: please add a short note under "Dashboards" that panel queries should use `COALESCE(ingest_rps, requests_per_min)` for the next 2 weeks. saves customers from 404 on saved queries.

maria: good call. I'll add that and then request merge. merging after CI green?

kevin: yep merge once preview and smoke tests pass. I'll coordinate the billing blog post about the tier rename.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
